components.name: Button
components.priorityHint: Use one primary per section; secondary/ghost for repeated actions
components.keyInsightSeed: OpenAI buttons are quiet but decisive: rounded rectangles, no uppercase, generous horizontal padding.

components.name: Card
components.priorityHint: Keep cards scannable: one headline, short description, clear category
components.keyInsightSeed: Cards behave like editorial panels: generous padding, soft borders, and restrained shadows.

components.name: Input
components.priorityHint: Reserve visible borders; use focus ring for accessibility
components.keyInsightSeed: Inputs are understated: thin neutral borders, no background tint, clear focus state.

components.name: Badge
components.priorityHint: Use pills for categories, statuses, and metadata; avoid long text
components.keyInsightSeed: Badges are tiny editorial markers: pill-shaped, light weight, often outline.

components.name: CTA Link
components.priorityHint: Use arrow links to lead users into deeper content; keep label concise
components.keyInsightSeed: CTA links feel editorial: a short phrase and a single arrow, no button chrome.

components.name: Navigation
components.priorityHint: Keep nav sparse; use transparent style on hero and solid on scroll
components.keyInsightSeed: Navigation is intentionally minimal: a logo, a few links, and one primary action.
